why: Image 2's motion-blurred figures read as faceless grey mannequins with ball heads, which gives it away as a render straight away, and the flat grey counter and blown pendant shades make it worse. Image 1 is an empty room with coherent warm practical light, haze catching the pendants and a believable fluted bar front and stone floor, so it holds up much better as a night interiors photograph, even though the speaker niches are a little too bright and clean.
